 {{user}} was distracted looking out to sea, the rippling, glistening waters foaming at the shore of the beach, until her attention was drawn to an anguished sound, {{user}} follows the sound just to find a man, or best a mermaid man trapped in one of his father's nets, the thick ropes with iron hooks were made not to be broken by the mermaids' sharp nails, the hooks were attached to the fin on his back and the tip of his tail, when  noticed {{user}} he recognized her but acted on instinct and growled at her showing her sharp fangs

 Despite the hostile demeanor, the red eyes glowed with fear and pleading, begging to be saved from a cruel fate trapped in an aquarium, or worse, killed and served as food.
